get_config_hcl: get the FermiNet QMC configuration for HCl excited states with pseudopotentials
finalize_pyscf_mol: finalize a config by building a pyscf Mole object with pseudopotentials for the HCl molecule
run_hcl_qmc: run a quantum Monte Carlo calculation on HCl using the FermiNet config with 3 excited states
create_hcl_molecule: create an HCl molecule config with hydrogen and chlorine atoms at specified coordinates
configure_pseudopotentials: configure pseudopotentials for chlorine atoms in the HCl molecule using the cc-pvdz basis set
